messages.subject: Inla Can't fit model
parts:
Hi There,

I am running a tweedie INLA model with a spatiotemporal random effect with a prediction stack, Inla can't fit the model and displays this error after reaching smart optimise part IV

"Mode not sufficient accurate; switch to a stupid local search strategy.
enable early_stop ff < f0: -24768.222376 < -24768.219222
enable early_stop ff < f0: -24768.223449 < -24768.222376
exit diagonal hessian due to early_stop"

this repeats over and over and inla can't finish fitting the model

can anyone offer some advise?

Cheers,
Sylvan

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Inla Can't fit model
parts:
the optimiser has been unable to find an accurate mode, so when it tries
to compute the Hessian at the mode, it find a better point, and there
you go.

The problem is likely somewhere else, explaining why this is the case.
maybe the posterior is very flat, hence more informative priors will
help.

You may try to change some initial values for some of the
hyperparameters, to see if that helps. you'll see from the output with
verbose=T what their numerical values are more likely
